title: The Eight Extremes Sect
summary: Spirits chase Lin Dong, Little Flame and Little Mink through the ruins into a hall full of stone statues. Lin Dong hears voices and links his Mental Strength with the statues. He learns that this was the Eight Extremes Sect, whose disciples fought the same monsters seen in the Great Desolate Ancient Tablet. They turned themselves to stone to power the Nirvana Heaven-Burning Array, with one statue as its core. Brute force fails, but the Stone Talisman breaks the core and the array ends. Mu Sha then ambushes them and uses a Spirit Driving Art to control the statues. When Lin Dong presses him, the formation's end wakes the sect's guardian beast, a Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, and Mu Sha seizes control of it.
events: Spirits chase the group into a dead end and then a hall of stone statues.
Lin Dong's Mental Strength links with the statues and shows him the Eight Extremes Sect's last battle.
The disciples sacrificed themselves to the Nirvana Heaven-Burning Array.
The Stone Talisman breaks the array's core statue and frees the sect's disciples.
Mu Sha ambushes them and drives the statues with a Spirit Driving Art.
Lin Dong attacks Mu Sha directly, since he can use only one Mental Strength skill at a time.
A Primordial Demon Dragon Hound, the sect's guardian beast, wakes and Mu Sha takes control of it.
